name: Not Just a Coincidence
original_name: 九爷你家小祖宗不想负责
overview: When business tycoon An Nansheng’s fiancé spends their wedding night with another woman, she embraces her newfound freedom—until a chance encounter with the powerful Mu Family’s Ninth Lord turns out to be more than it seems. Mistaking him for a male escort, she unwittingly plays into his elaborate plan, and only when she truly falls for him does she realize nothing was accidental.
